title: Quantitative inference-arbitrage scan and decision engine
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a repeatable quantitative process (scan + decision engine) to identify profitable inference arbitrage opportunities across public and private model variants, cloud regions, and deployment modes. The output should be a prioritized set of actionable plays (e.g., route low-latency traffic to cheaper regional quantized variants, earmark reserved capacity for predictable high-volume customers, or flag models for canary fallbacks). This ticket focuses on the research and MVP decisioning layer: data inputs, scoring heuristics, monitoring hooks, and an operator-facing report template.
deliverables: Scan spec: signal catalog and ingestion plan (price, latency, availability, quantization readiness, SLA tier)
Scoring rubric and prioritization engine prototype (weights, thresholds, confidence bands)
MVP decision dashboard mockup and one-click runbook for short-term routing actions
Backtest notebook showing historical arbitrage opportunities on last 12 months of telemetry
Operational runbook and acceptance criteria for automated alerts to Capacity and Runtime teams
acceptance_criteria: Scorecard produces consistent top-20 opportunities, validated by manual review on sample week
Backtest shows >10% unit-cost improvement in identified scenarios without breaching latency SLOs
Dashboard mockup reviewed and approved by Runtime and Sales Ops
Runbook includes clear escalation paths and a rollback plan for any automated routing change
tasks: Assemble signal catalog and data providers (billing, traceroutes, region capacity, model variant metadata)
Implement lightweight scoring prototype in a Jupyter notebook
Define feature weights and sensitivity tests with economics owner
Design dashboard wireframe and alert semantics
Run backtest on 12 months of anonymized customer telemetry
Prepare handoff doc and runbook for Runtime and Dedicated teams
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting — aligned on goal to produce operator-safe plays rather than fully automated routing in v1.

2026-03-11: Runtime engineering flagged potential safety guard: only apply routing changes when 95th latency percentile remains under threshold for 24h.
2026-03-14: Design reviewed dashboard wireframe; added manual override and audit trail requirement per Compliance feedback.
2026-03-15: Backtest pipeline proof-of-concept ran on a subset of traffic; initial results show median unit-cost improvement 7% for stable workloads, TODO: expand to all tenants.
